_STOP_MEMORY_FLOOR_GB.the_ruled_semantics_recorded_here_so_nob: scripts/queue_runner.py:195-200, mem_available_gb(), reads the MemAvailable line of /proc/meminfo -- which the kernel reports in kB -- and returns int(line.split()[1]) / (1024.0 * 1024.0). kB / 1024 / 1024 IS GIBIBYTES. The name and the log line are both wrong about the unit; the arithmetic is the authority. CONSEQUENCE FOR WHOEVER FILLS THIS FIELD: A FLOOR ALREADY EXPRESSED IN GiB GOES IN UNCONVERTED. Converting GiB to GB before writing it would raise the effective floor by 7.4 % and hold the run on a box that is in fact above it.
